# gravitino_user Data Source



## Example Usage

```terraform
data "gravitino_user" "example" {
  metalake = "example_metalake"
  name     = "data_analyst"
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `metalake` (String) The metalake name.
- `name` (String) The user name.

### Read-Only

- `audit` (Object) Audit information for the user. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--audit))
- `roles` (Set of String) The roles assigned to the user.

<a id="nestedatt--audit"></a>
### Nested Schema for `audit`

Read-Only:

- `create_time` (String)
- `creator` (String)
- `last_modified_time` (String)
- `last_modifier` (String)
